scope: All 29 zscope/tools Python files, the shared argument validator, and directly affected Agent/Joern execution boundaries. This is not a whole-repository audit.

security_reliability: Pinned project-root identity; consistent exclusion rules and restricted symbol visibility; no arbitrary legacy file reads.
Bounded local regex matching; remote Joern receives literal sink names.
Structured audit errors, hook reasons and provider failures avoid credential disclosure.
Missing, corrupt, stale, truncated and unavailable results stay distinct.
simplicity: Shared output validation and trimming between runtime and Agent; shared physical-line splitting.
Removed duplicate legacy list query and validation-time full file read.
Condensed repeated tool descriptions while preserving parameter and evidence constraints.
maintainability: One public ToolContract source; returned schemas cannot mutate live validation rules.
Precise file/signature/USR constraints and recursive coverage propagation.
Kept still-imported legacy public tool classes and explicit unsupported behavior.
Added focused regression cases and stable module documentation.
performance: Binary-search result trimming instead of removing and serializing one record at a time.
Reverse reachability pruning and lazy DFS instead of exponential breadth-first path-prefix queues.
A shared 100000-expansion budget for recursive flow queries; 200 nodes per emitted path.
Static finding symbol lookup grouped once per file per query; SQLite handles explicitly closed.
design: 60,000-character output boundary includes diagnostics; complete records/physical source lines and usable continuation metadata.
Regex matching budgets are distinct from remote backend execution deadlines.
Current function semantics require matching source hash and build scope; advisory/global results are not falsely current.
Query status, coverage, source identity and recovery information remain explicit.

protocol_decisions.success_and_status: Retained: legacy boolean consumers coexist with detailed ok/partial/unavailable/error statuses.
protocol_decisions.coverage: Retained: a successful request or an empty result does not establish complete analysis.
protocol_decisions.provenance_and_identity: Retained: callers need the actual function, file and build/source version to assess evidence.
protocol_decisions.pagination_and_source_continuation: Retained: bounded responses must remain retrievable without skipped records or false complete definitions.
protocol_decisions.warnings_and_errors: Retained for actionable causes and recovery; secrets are not diagnostic content.
